title: Peaceful Harvest
description: Peaceful Harvest is not about making things easier—it’s about making them possible.
body:
Peaceful Harvest is a progression-focused Minecraft mod designed to make Peaceful mode fully playable—without removing the need to explore, gather, and survive.

Instead of hostile mobs, the world itself becomes your resource.

In vanilla Minecraft, many essential items are locked behind combat. Peaceful Harvest reimagines that progression by integrating mob drops naturally into world generation, environmental systems, and unique mechanics—so you can play without fighting, but still work for your resources.

🌿 World Generation Overhaul
The world is filled with new blocks, plants, and structures that replace traditional mob farming:

Remnant Coarse Dirt generates across the overworld, hiding drops like bones, rotten flesh, and leather.

Saltpeter Deposits and Sulfuric Netherrack provide materials to craft gunpowder.

Withered Netherrack introduces a new way to obtain wither-related drops, including skull fragments.

Shulker Scraped End Stone allows access to shulker resources in the End.

Every dimension now has its own way of providing what mobs once did.

🌳 Unique Flora & Trees
New plant life plays a major role in progression:

Silk Trees generate naturally and contain infested logs that may spawn white spiders.

Silk Leaves can drop string, making early-game crafting smoother.

Ender Lilies, Ember Lilies, and Tearblooms provide rare drops like ender pearls, blaze materials, and ghast tears.

Insanya grows deep underground and yields phantom membranes.

These are not farms—you’ll need to explore to find them.

🕷️ New Mob Variant
White Spiders are neutral creatures that only appear from Silk Trees.

They can be bred (currently with rotten flesh) and drop string and spider eyes.

This keeps mob interaction optional and controlled.

🔧 New Crafting Paths
Key items have been reworked to fit peaceful progression:

Gunpowder is craftable using Sulfur + Saltpeter + Coal

Shulker Shells can be crafted from End resources

Nether Stars can be assembled through a custom recipe

Arabic Gum and Pine Sap introduce new utility crafting options

⚖️ Designed for Balance
Peaceful Harvest is not about making things easier—it’s about making them possible.

Resources are distributed across dimensions

Exploration is required for progression

Drop rates and generation are tuned to avoid trivial farming

You won’t fight mobs—but you also won’t skip the grind.

🎯 Core Philosophy
No combat. No shortcuts. Just smart survival.

If you enjoy exploration, environmental storytelling, and alternative progression systems, Peaceful Harvest offers a fresh way to experience Minecraft.
Peaceful Harvest pairs exceptionally well with mods like 

-[Peaceful Hunger](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/peaceful-hunger)

-[Peaceful Depletion](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/peaceful-depletion)
